SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER, INV_NO, INV_SEQ, STATUS FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND WHERE BUYER = 'KRYUDO0008' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER, INV_NO, INV_SEQ, STATUS
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.BUYER, A.INV_NO AS KEP_INV_NO, A.INV_SEQ AS KEP_INV_SEQ, CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'C' THEN 'I' ELSE 'D' END AS STATUS, A.LEGACY_PO_NO, A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.ITEM_QTY, A.INV_DATE FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND A.INV_SEQ = '$G_RS.INV_SEQ$' AND A.STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND A.INV_SEQ = '$G_RS.INV_SEQ$' AND A.STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND A.INV_SEQ = '$G_RS.INV_SEQ$' AND A.STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$'
